package.name: jetnano_teleop
package.description: Teleoperation for the jetnano robot. teleop_node detects which controller is attached - a two-device Thrustmaster HOTAS set or a single Xbox pad - and publishes cmd_vel_teleop plus an e_stop lock for twist_mux; web_teleop serves a driving page (camera feed and a virtual joystick) for a phone or a laptop and publishes cmd_vel_web.
